_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 45 (Joseph reveals himself). Saadia-specific: v.10 'בלד אלסדיר' = 'land of al-Sadir' for גשן (Saadia identifies Goshen with the Sadir region of Egypt — Nile delta area); v.21 'עגלא' = 'wagons/carts' (consistent rendering of עגלות); v.24 'לא תרגזו' = 'do not be agitated' for אל תרגזו ('do not quarrel/be afraid').

translations.1: And Joseph could not restrain himself, because of the many standing before him; and he called: 'Let every man go out from my presence.' And no man stood with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
translations.2: And he raised his voice in weeping; and the Egyptians heard, and Pharaoh's house heard.
translations.3: Then Joseph said to his brothers: 'I am Joseph. Is my father still alive?' But they could not answer him — for they were dismayed before him.
translations.4: Until he said to them: 'Come near to me' — and they came near. And he said: 'I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
translations.5: And now — do not grieve, and let it not be hard upon you, that you sold me here; for God has sent me before you for sustenance.
translations.6: For these two years the famine has been in the land; and there are yet five years, in which there shall be neither sowing nor harvest.
translations.7: And God has sent me before you, to make for you a remainder in the earth, and to keep alive for you a great deliverance.
translations.8: And now — it was not you who sent me here, but God; and He has made me a master to Pharaoh, and a lord over all his house, and a ruler over all the land of Egypt.
translations.9: Hasten and go up to my father, and say to him: "Thus said your son Joseph: God has made me a lord over all the Egyptians; come down to me, do not delay.
translations.10: And dwell in the land of al-Sadir (Goshen); and you shall be near me — you and your sons and your sons' sons, and your sheep and your cattle and all that you have.
translations.11: And I shall sustain you there — for there remain five years of famine — lest you be brought to want, you and your household and all that you have."
translations.12: And behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
translations.13: And tell my father of all my honor in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and hasten, and bring him down here.'
translations.14: And he fell upon the neck of Benjamin his brother, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
translations.15: And he kissed all his brothers, and wept upon them; and after that his brothers spoke with him.
translations.16: And the voice was raised — to Pharaoh, saying: 'Joseph's brothers have come.' And it pleased Pharaoh, and his officers.
translations.17: And Pharaoh said to Joseph: 'Say to your brothers: do this — load your animals, and go, return to the land of Canaan.
translations.18: And bring your father and your households, and come to me; I shall give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the choicest of what is in it.
translations.19: And you are commanded to say to them: do this — take for yourselves from the land of Egypt wagons for your little ones and your wives, and bring your father, and come.
translations.20: And let your eyes not spare your vessels — for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.'
translations.21: And the children of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them wagons, by Pharaoh's command; and he gave them provisions for the way.
translations.22: And to each man he gave a robe; and to Benjamin he gave three hundred drachma, and five robes.
translations.23: And to his father he sent ten donkeys laden with the best of Egypt, and ten she-asses laden with grain and food and provisions for his father for the way.
translations.24: And he sent his brothers away, and they went; and he said to them: 'Do not be agitated on the way.'
translations.25: And they went up from Egypt, and came to the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
translations.26: And they told him, and said to him: 'Joseph is still alive — and he is a ruler over all the land of Egypt.' And his heart wavered — for he did not trust them.
translations.27: And they spoke with him all the words of Joseph which he had spoken to them; and he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him; and the spirit of Jacob their father was revived.
translations.28: And Israel said: 'Enough — Joseph my son is still alive. I shall go and see him before I die.'
